title: Verify no financial data is shown to Time Clock user
preconds: Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Time Clock role. (this role has See Financial Data OFF and View Mode Empty).
steps:
1. Open every screen reachable by the Time Clock user (clock control, and Work Orders/Schedule if visible per spec v39).
2. Look for any price, total, or other money value.
expected: No pricing or financial data is displayed on any screen reachable by the Time Clock user.
